report:
Brain, left temporal tumour

Received in formalin are fragments of soft tumour tissue from the temporal lobe, measuring 45 x 35 x 20 mm in aggregate. The cut surface is firm and grey-white. Representative sections are taken; see block key.

(A1-A6) tumour.

Specimen
- Procedure: Craniotomy and excision
- Tumour site: Left temporal lobe
- Specimen integrity: Fragmented, received in pieces

Microscopic findings
- Tumour histology:
  Sections show a diffusely infiltrating astrocytic neoplasm in which atypical glial cells with elongated hyperchromatic nuclei permeate the cortex and white matter. The tumour shows increased cellularity, nuclear atypia, mitotic activity and gemistocytic change. Mitoses number 5 per 10 high-power fields. On immunohistochemistry, the tumour cells are positive for GFAP and OLIG2. The Ki-67 proliferation index is approximately 14 per cent. On molecular testing, IDH1 R132H is expressed, an IDH mutation is detected (IDH1 p.R132H), there is loss of nuclear ATRX expression, p53 shows an abnormal pattern (mutated pattern), 1p and 19q are retained and there is homozygous deletion of CDKN2A/B.
- Treatment effect: No known presurgical therapy

Integrated diagnosis
- Integrated diagnosis: Astrocytoma, IDH-mutant, CNS WHO grade 4
- Histopathological classification: Anaplastic astrocytoma
- CNS WHO grade: 4

Molecular information
- IDH1 R132H (immunohistochemistry): Positive
- IDH1 / IDH2 sequencing: Mutation detected (IDH1 p.R132H)
- ATRX (immunohistochemistry): Loss of nuclear expression
- p53 (immunohistochemistry): Abnormal (mutated pattern)
- 1p/19q (FISH): No deletion detected
- CDKN2A / CDKN2B: Homozygous deletion detected

Additional findings
- None identified

BRAIN, left temporal lobe, craniotomy and excision
- ASTROCYTOMA, IDH-mutant, CNS WHO grade 4; see synoptic report

MGMT promoter methylation testing has been requested; the result will be issued in a supplementary report.

The case has been referred to the neuro-oncology multidisciplinary meeting.
